market_summary: EURUSD presents a clean bearish breakdown out of value area supported by strong negative CVD during London session. XAUUSD and US100 are holding bullish baseline trends above VWAP/EMA50 but are consolidating near key resistance levels without immediate momentum expansion. GBPUSD is testing session lows with neutral delta divergence, while BTCUSD shows upper wick rejections near 74k with bearish CVD divergence, keeping the broader market predominantly selective or in hold states.

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 4039.33..VAH 4059.52) and above POC 4044.58. CVD is NEUTRAL (-0.69) with a slightly negative slope (-0.19). Current session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is holding above VWAP (4048.72) and EMA50 (4051.07), but consolidating near mid-channel (EMA20 4052.72) and resisting at S/R 4052.38. Volume lacks RVOL spikes (0.738). Without clear expansion volume or directional delta, holding is prudent.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bullish context above VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL 1.11445 and below POC 1.11658, indicating bearish value acceptance. CVD is BEARISH (-3710.26), confirming aggressive selling pressure. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Volume profile shows recent yellow RVOL activity confirming the breakdown out of the value area.

Price trades below VAL 1.33232 and below POC 1.33468. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is below VWAP (1.33343) and EMA50 (1.33381), touching the lower ATR band (1.33146). CVD is NEUTRAL (-1421.0), showing a slight divergence as delta fails to aggressively expand downward alongside price. Given price is directly testing multi-touch Session Low (1.33141) without strong sell delta alignment, entry carries bounce risk.

Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 28017.71..VAH 28261.60) and above POC 28114.25. CVD is BULLISH (+8.28) but short-term slope is turning negative (-0.22). Session is LONDON_SESSION. Trend is structurally strong above rising VWAP (28078.45) and EMA50 (28066.38), but price is currently stretched near upper ATR band (28259.00) after hitting Session High 28261.60. US100 tick volume rarely prints RVOL > 2.0; however, entry at the immediate top of the range is unideal without a pullback.

Price is above VAH 73808.59 and above POC 73660.40. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price remains above VWAP (73644.23) and EMA50 (73694.06). However, CVD is BEARISH (-0.04) showing negative divergence against the recent price push. Signal bar wicked off Session High 74085.20 and rejected back below S/R 73975.30. RVOL is standard (1.089). Divergent delta and upper wick rejection warrant a neutral stance.
